title: Time Jump: Friday 09:00, Sea Day, Formal Night Ahead

fields.jumpLabel: +3 hours 20 minutes of story time (from 05:40 to 09:00 Friday)
fields.narration: Pause the discussion. We are moving the clock forward. It is now 09:00 Central ship time on Friday, February 19, 2027. MV Halcyon Dawn is on a sea day, about 300 nautical miles northwest of Cozumel, heading for Galveston. The weather has not changed: clear skies, wind east around 12 knots, seas 3 to 4 feet. Whatever you decided at the bridge door at 05:40 about the Lido breakfast, the kids club craft and the matinee is now in force, and guests are noticing. At 06:15 Dr. Fiona Gallagher signed the 06:00 medical log entry. That entry is the latest signed count on board, and it went ashore in this morning's 07:00 daily count. The 08:00 shoreside call has ended. Down the corridors, 61 guest cabin doors now carry the 'Medical Service Required: Do Not Enter' sign, and isolation meals are reaching those cabins about 40 minutes late. Guest Wi-Fi traffic is the highest it has been all voyage. Tonight is formal night. At 09:00, right now, Guest Care opens the family hotline because more than 1 percent of passengers are ill. The first agents are logging in, and they have no script yet. Take a moment to re-read the board, then pick up from here.
worldState: Clock: 09:00 Central ship time, Friday, February 19, 2027. Sea day, about 300 nautical miles northwest of Cozumel. Arrival in Galveston is still scheduled for 07:00 Sunday, February 21.
Weather: clear, wind east about 12 knots, seas 3 to 4 feet. Ship's systems and navigation are normal.
Latest signed medical log entry: 06:00, signed by Dr. Fiona Gallagher at 06:15. Cumulative reportable AGE cases since embarkation February 14: PASSENGERS 61 (2.0% of 2,980), CREW 12 (1.1% of 1,120).
The 07:00 daily count to shoreside used the 06:00 signed entry. The 08:00 shoreside call has ended.
The 05:40 decisions on the Lido breakfast buffet, the 10:00 kids club shared craft and the 14:00 show lounge matinee are in force. Guests are commenting on them in public areas and online.
61 guest cabins have the 'Medical Service Required: Do Not Enter' sign on the door. Isolation meal routes are running about 40 minutes late.
Guest Wi-Fi traffic is at its highest level of the voyage.
Tonight is formal night, with the gala in the main dining rooms.
The family hotline (800-555-0120 opens at 09:00 (staffed 06:00 to 24:00 Central). The first agents are on the phones without a script.
Stool specimens from 12 passengers are still at the contracted lab ashore. Results are due Friday at 14:00.
fields.facilitatorNote: Players must re-baseline on one number: 61 passengers and 12 crew, signed at 06:15. Challenge any role that quotes 60, 52, the 2,978 manifest figure or the 'over 100' rumor. Ask PH to show that the 2 percent passenger special report went to the VSP, both by phone and in writing (policy: within 1 hour of the 05:10 count that reached the threshold, per HR-HSP-02 section 5), with same-day copies to the Galveston County Health District and the Texas Department of State Health Services (section 6). If the report or the copies were missed, have players log the gap and fix it now. Crew are at 1.1 percent and below the threshold, so no crew special report is due. Do not hint at later case counts.
fields.scenarioTitle: Same Count, Every Channel — Norovirus Thresholds, Reporting & Turnaround

instructorNote: This card moves everyone onto the 06:00 signed count (61 passengers and 12 crew, signed 06:15) as the only number any channel may use. Watch whether PH can confirm that the 2 percent special report and phone call went to the VSP and that copies went to the Galveston County Health District and Texas DSHS. If they cannot, the gap should be logged and fixed now. Also watch whether COMMS gets a script to the hotline agents with the signed count and the time it was signed.
